ModMetaData.name: Druidkin - Wild Shape
ModMetaData.author: throwingfish
ModMetaData.description:
Become a Druid.
Adds a Biotech xenotype, the Druid, whose gene lets a pawn Wild Shape into an animal's body - taking on its stats, speed, and combat capability - and shift back whenever they choose. Equipment and inventory are held safely while shifted and returned automatically on reverting.
Starting forms: rat, timber wolf, cougar, grizzly bear, muffalo, megasloth.
Requires the Biotech DLC.
